phase: External Source Screening — Sectoral Financial Positions
purpose: Screen official sources outside the already exhausted retained ECB-QSA query path for a possible future source-reopen trigger. Screening does not change the reference-mode target, accounting state or readiness and does not treat a new dissemination layer as independent evidence without source-lineage review.

stocks.title: Quarterly Financial Balance Sheets (stocks) - counterpart information

positive_evidence: OECD explicitly describes both quarterly counterpart-position and counterpart-flow tables by institutional sector and financial instrument.
The OECD Data Explorer exposes SDMX API endpoints for both dataflows.
The counterpart tables can in principle represent relationships between non-financial corporations, financial corporations, government, households/NPISH and rest of world by instrument.
lineage_boundary: OECD states that Quarterly Sector Accounts (financial part) are an OECD-ECB collection.
Therefore an OECD observation is not assumed to be statistically independent from the ECB/European financial-accounts source chain.
A future retained Romania result must record its source metadata/lineage before it can count as a source-reopen trigger.

access_operational_context.interpretation: Provider throttling/access failures are INDETERMINATE and cannot be treated as absent Romania data.

scope_limit: The retained Romania counterpart tables contain exact F2-F8 instrument codes for both stocks and financial transactions.
Reporting sectors are limited to S1/S11/S12/S13/S1M and counterpart sectors to S1/S11/S12/S13/S1M/S2; S121 central bank is absent.
Therefore RMD BNR cannot be observed and RMD F = S12 - S121 cannot be constructed without a prohibited assumption.

positive_evidence: Eurostat quarterly financial-flows/stocks metadata explicitly identifies nasq_10_f_cp as Financial accounts: counterpart information.
The mandatory core quarterly dataset includes who-to-whom tables for deposits and short-term/long-term loans, with mandatory backdata from 2012-Q4.
Counterpart-sector details for securities are mandatory from 2013-Q4.
The reference area covers all EU Member States and dissemination frequency is quarterly.
lineage_boundary: Quarterly financial-account data are reported to the ECB, validated there and transmitted to Eurostat for republication.
Therefore Eurostat is not assumed to be a statistically independent source from the existing European financial-accounts chain.
Its scientific value here is potential access to an explicit counterpart dissemination table that was not yet retained in the RMD source-recovery chain.
scope_limit: Discovery confirms Romania counterpart rows and schema, but the retained na_item code set is not the complete RMD F2-F8 instrument boundary.
F2 lacks F21 currency; F5 is partial; F6/F7/F8 are absent.
No historical extraction or reference-mode promotion is authorized from Eurostat nasq_10_f_cp under the frozen RMD boundary.
The 2024 annual CNF report exposes a non-consolidated sector-by-counterpart stock matrix with S121 and AF2-AF8, allowing exact semantic mapping of the RMD sectors for that annual stock snapshot.
The counterpart-matrix section is explicitly stocks for 2024; it is not a quarterly counterpart history.
No matched quarterly F2-F8 financial-transaction counterpart history is identified in the screened annual publication.
The frozen reference-mode extraction contract requires quarterly stock and financial transactions with at least 40 common quarters, so this source cannot promote the mode or change readiness.

decision.next_admissible_action: Hold the external counterpart recovery path closed. Eurostat passed discovery but failed the frozen F2-F8 instrument scope; OECD passed discovery and complete instrument scope but failed the frozen RMD sector scope because S121 is absent for Romania. The latest official BNR annual CNF publication adds a strong national semantic cross-check: its 2024 non-consolidated counterpart stock matrix exposes S121 and AF2-AF8, but it fails the frozen quarterly-frequency and stock+financial-transaction-history requirements. Reopen only on a declared new-source or changed-dataset trigger capable of supplying exact S121 sector separation and complete F2-F8 quarterly stocks and transactions. Do not repeat the same source probes merely because readiness remains 9/10.
decision.discovery_pass_effect: A discovery PASS does not authorize value extraction or promotion. It only opens the frozen Semantic + Lineage Review, which must pass before a separate exact historical extraction contract can be preregistered.
